results.question: How many companies entered the AI device market each year?
results.generated_sql:
WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT company_name, min(decision_date) AS first_decision_date
  FROM fda_510k
  GROUP BY company_name
)
SELECT CAST(year(first_decision_date) AS INTEGER) AS first_clearance_year,
       count(*) AS n_companies
FROM firsts
GROUP BY first_clearance_year
ORDER BY first_clearance_year
